description: Logs the outcome of a single combat action, created by a game logic service.

type.description: The mechanical type of the outcome.

amount.description: The numerical value of the outcome (e.g., damage dealt, health restored).

statusEffectKey.description: The unique key for the status effect involved, if any (e.g., 'poison').

combatRef.description: A strong reference to the master combat instance record.

actionRef.description: A strong reference to the combat.action record that produced this result.

actorRef.description: A strong reference to the actor who performed the action.

targetRef.description: A strong reference to the primary target of the action.

narrative.description: A user-facing description of what happened (e.g., 'You strike the Goblin for 8 damage!').
